'''Karkalnadag''' is a northern Khalari state or region. The extracted geography source calls it the United Provinces of Karkalnadag, while the 2003 and 2022 map references label it as the Karkalnadag Kingdom.

== Geography ==

Karkalnadag is described as a northern land of glaciers, taiga forests, tundra, wetlands, temperate rainforest, river systems, and southern mountains. The Geden River is named in the source as a major waterway supporting settlement, ecology, and travel.

== Political Profile ==

The source presents Karkalnadag as quiet and diplomatically reserved, better known for natural landscapes and hospitality than for aggressive foreign policy. Its southern mountains form an important borderland with neighboring Khalari states, including the [[Svetkhanul Republic]].

== Source Limits ==

The conflict between United Provinces and Kingdom language is not resolved in this draft. It may reflect an old source name, a constitutional monarchy with provincial structures, a later map-era rename, or a canon inconsistency. Publication needs a user ruling or a dedicated Khalari government-name pass.
